name: Permissions
description: Lists every caller's grants and revokes them, and asks the person when a caller requests a permission.

commands.title: Permissions: approve the run
commands.description: Approve the approval an agent's run waits for (its approval id, from the fleet board), once or, with answer task, for the rest of the task.

commands.title: Permissions: deny the run
commands.description: Deny the approval an agent's run waits for (its approval id, from the fleet board).

commands.title: Permissions: stop the run
commands.description: Stop an agent's run by its item id (run) and source: a waiting run is denied, a running command is answered cancelled, a plugin's run is stopped by the plugin.
